title: Data Agent Solution / Query-as-Verified-Pipeline
note: Upper-layer solution exploration, not a core protocol lock. Records the Data Agent preset direction: query-as-verified-pipeline built from messaging hub, orchestration/pipeline helpers, job queues/flows, guarded execution, agentic memory, async/remote runtime adapters, and semantic/warehouse/catalog adapters. Separates vertical solution work from the clean-slate narrow-waist foundation.
